versions.changelog: Metadata only: set topics (ai-workflow,documentation); categories unchanged. No content change.
Metadata only: set categories (Development, Productivity). No content change.
Rename: docs-gov is the new name; the old slug redirects here. Package name and self-references updated, no behaviour change.

Read boundary: every file read now stays inside the repository. audit's CI-workflow, scripts/ and .claude/settings.json reads, the decision index README, root entry docs, and the config file are skipped (or refused, for the config) when they resolve outside the repo through a symlink. 6 regression tests spy on every read; a sweep symlinking every candidate path outside finds zero outside reads across audit, all check modes and init planning. 176 tests pass.

Fix a bug the 2.0.5 fix introduced: a pre-existing Claude Code hook file is now registered only if its sha256 matches the bundled template. Previously any existing file under the managed hook name was registered as a trusted hook without checking its contents, so a pre-positioned file would run as one. On a mismatch neither hook is registered, both digests are reported, and the dry-run plan states this before anything is written. 2 new regression tests; 170 pass.

init never overwrites an existing file: with one managed Claude Code hook present and the other missing, init used to rewrite both. Existing files are now preserved and reported; only .claude/settings.json is merged. 2 new regression tests; 168 pass.

Recognise ADR- prefixed decision files (ADR-0017-slug.md) and TASK- plans (same rules as PLAN-, including the D-tier contradiction check). Previously such repositories were reported as having no decision records or plans, and their files were silently skipped. 7 new regression tests; 166 pass.

2.0.3: init now installs only the governance.py you actually ran (its path and sha256 are shown in the plan before --yes); DOC_GOVERNANCE_HOME no longer selects installed code or hook templates and is used only for pre-commit's read-only drift comparison. Requirements are declared in the frontmatter (metadata.openclaw: bins, config files, env vars). Two stale notes in incidents.md corrected. 159 tests.

2.0.2: completes the repository-boundary fix from the second audit round — every init write (including the .git/hooks forwarding shim and .claude/settings.json) is checked on its own right before writing, so symlinks leading outside the repo are skipped and reported; a settings.json that isn't a JSON object is left untouched. 156 tests.

2.0.1: security hardening from the ClawHub audit — config and link paths are confined to the repository root (absolute paths, .. and outward symlinks refused; cascade targets outside the repo are reported, never read; init won't write through outward symlinks); description now warns up front that init installs persistent hooks; triggers limited to explicit requests; new 'What it touches' scope table. 152 tests.

2.0.0: full English version. Checks now recognize both English and Chinese documentation phrasing (deferred promises, Status lines and table rows, Cascade memo sections, implementation-status labels, source-of-truth declarations, before/after checkpoints). 145 tests.
首发：给项目装一套文档治理架构并持续检查文档与现实是否分叉——audit 七组件诊断、init 一键装闸门与 hook、check 九种模式；136 条测试，其中 103 条绑真实事故。
